title: Character weight subspaces at a fixed rational point of a scheme
statement: Let $F$ be a field [def-weil-field], $X$ an $F$-scheme [def-pc-scheme], and $a:\mathbf G_m\times_F X\to X$ an action, with $\mathbf G_m$ as in [def-sc-gm-ga]. For $p\in X$, use the canonical residue-field vector space $T_{X/F,p}$ of dual-number tangent vectors [def-sc-scheme-tangent-space]. For $n\in\mathbb Z$, define $W_n(p)$ to be the $\kappa(p)$-linear span of the vectors $v$ for which, for every $t\in F^\times$, the actual action of the constant dual-number point $t$ on $v$ equals the tangent point of $\bar t^{\,n}v$, where $\bar t$ is the image under the structural map $F\to\kappa(p)$. Define $T_pX_{>0}=\sum_{n>0}W_n(p)$. At a rational fixed point over an algebraically closed $F$, these are the character eigenspaces for $t\mapsto t^n$ and their strictly positive sum; this uses character weights, not eigenvalues of the differentiated character. The auxiliary maps are the structural residue scalar map and the existing tangent vector viewed as a morphism over $F$ from its dual-number spectrum.
